profile_text.body:
Zhejiang University is a university in Hangzhou, China, described in its profile as a nonprofit university lab. Its English-language site carries research news and seminar announcements. Among the items shown are a technique developed by researchers in China to produce super-resolution images without external light excitation, instead using faint light generated by chemical reactions; work led by XIANG Rong of the School of Mechanical Engineering on the first preferred synthesis of transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMDC) nanotubes, addressing control of chirality during synthesis; and work on vinblastine, for which the Madagascar periwinkle remains the only known natural source.

The site also lists lectures, including talks by Xinyue Ye of the University of Alabama, Hans Koster of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, and Krzysztof Matyjaszewski, whose abstract notes polymers at over 400 million tons of annual production.

The material provided does not describe AI products or commercial AI offerings from the university. No litigation, no MCP servers, and no products are recorded for it.
